title: Chapter 19 Operation 4
content:
Chapter 19 Operation 4

It was already past 5pm. According to the last experience, the crocodile would come for a patrol in the evening. Time was running out, so Wang Shuo hurried back and ordered a takeaway to replenish his energy.

After eating and drinking and resting, Wang Shuo took out a few fish and threw them at the entrance of the maze.

Holding a fine spear in his hand, Wang Shuo quietly waited for the arrival of the elite crocodile.

After equipping the spear, Wang Shuo's strength had reached 10 points. He was at his peak at the moment and full of fighting spirit.

He glanced at the [Attribute Panel] again.

[ID: 5678 Wang Shuo]

[Level: Level 2]

[Strength: 10 (5+5)]

[Constitution: 7]

[Agility: 5]

[Energy: 13 (12+1)]

[Health: 270]

[Skills: 1, "Make peace", 2, "Make a mud pit". ]

[Equipment: 1, fine spear, strength +5, attack +10, durability 10/10. ]

[Equipment: 2, Rebound Necklace: Energy +1, can double the player's mental strength. ]

[Overall evaluation: With the equipment, you are no longer a weak chicken, but a fighting chicken among weak chickens. ]

Before dark, the elite crocodile came as promised, just like a neighbor visiting.

Standing 20 meters away from the crocodile, with the help of the sunset, Wang Shuo saw the "prehistoric giant crocodile" in front of him.

Even though Wang Shuo was mentally prepared, he was still taken by the momentum of the elite crocodile.

The sun shone on the crocodile's keratinous protrusions, shining with a metallic luster, and the huge and powerful limbs would leave deep footprints with every step.

He swallowed his saliva unconsciously, and suddenly felt his legs trembling a little, and his hands and feet were a little out of control.

He had no experience of facing such a terrible beast. What he saw on TV and what he faced in person were really different.

However, he still had the instinct to turn around and run when facing danger.

He regretted it now. What kind of crocodile-killing warrior is this? Is this something a normal person can do?

Unless he has a gun, a modern gun, how can he kill a monster that is only half a head shorter than him?

Look at its bloody mouth, the sharp teeth like daggers, and it only takes one bite to bite the prey in half.

Wang Shuo was panicked until he hid behind the first obstacle made of mud bricks, and then he breathed a sigh of relief. He was scared.

But the crocodile would not give him a chance to surrender. The moment the crocodile found him, the disguise of "good neighbor" was torn apart. This battle was destined to be either you die or I die.

Besides, Brother Crocodile has never admitted that it is a "good neighbor". All creatures in its territory are just its food.

The distance of 20 meters, in just a blink of an eye, the crocodile rushed into the trench, and the surrounding soil and mud bricks were knocked down by it, making a continuous "bang, bang" sound.

Every sound scared Wang Shuo.

His scalp tightened and his body felt a little stiff. The crocodile kept hitting the obstacles he set up, forcing him to tighten his mind and keep retreating.

After a long while, Wang Shuo got used to the terrifying battlefield atmosphere and began to fight back.

Seeing that the crocodile had just hit a wall made of earth bricks, Wang Shuo took a deep breath, raised his spear and stabbed.

But the hard crocodile skin had amazing defense. Wang Shuo's spear stabbed the crocodile's scalp and slid to the side without leaving even a cut.

After missing the first shot, Wang Shuo hurriedly retreated and came to a "Z" section. Wang Shuo took out his bow and arrow again, aimed at the crocodile's mouth, and shot an arrow.

The distance was only 5 meters, and Wang Shuo still easily shot it, but it did not cause any damage to it. Wang Shuo's arrow, like a toothpick, pierced very shallowly.

If Wang Shuo's strength was a little stronger, he might be able to make the crocodile feel pain, but at this time, it could only be regarded as tickling it.

Wang Shuo's arrow was still a success. He successfully saw the level and health bar of the elite crocodile.

At this time, the head of the elite crocodile showed, "Level 7 Elite Crocodile, HP: 1999/2000".

Wang Shuo took a breath of cold air. His own health was only 270, which was too big a gap.

Without time to think about it, Wang Shuo retreated a few steps and shot another arrow, but this time the crocodile was prepared and did not shoot into its mouth, and was successfully missed.

In this way, Wang Shuo fought and retreated, and fought the crocodile without any danger, although basically did not cause any damage to the crocodile.

As the battle continued, Wang Shuo gradually became calm from the panic at the beginning.

Came to a narrow place again, and the crocodile was stuck. Although this could only buy Wang Shuo a few seconds, this time he seized the opportunity and put the advanced fishing net on it, which was a tool he made urgently before the battle.

As expected, the crocodile was temporarily restrained. Wang Shuo quickly made up a few fishing nets and started to make a mud pit under the crocodile.

If the crocodile can be trapped again, it will be much easier to kill it.

This time it was relatively smooth. Wang Shuo only made a mud pit at the crocodile's hind legs. Soon the crocodile fell into a 2m×2m pit and stood up.

The crocodile's limbs were basically tied up, so it had limited power to struggle and it was difficult to climb out for a while.

Seeing that the crocodile was constantly destroying the mud pit with its mouth, Wang Shuo found the right opportunity and poured all the collected sulfuric acid solution into the crocodile's mouth.

Suddenly, the crocodile roared in pain.

Wang Shuo noticed that in the [System Prompt] column, prompts kept ringing:

[You caused 5 points of damage to the crocodile]

[You caused 5 points of damage to the crocodile]

...

Watching the crocodile's health bar slowly decrease, Wang Shuo finally breathed a sigh of relief.

But soon, the system prompt changed to:

[You caused 4 points of damage to the crocodile]

The crocodile will definitely not die if this continues.

Wang Shuo immediately used bricks to reinforce the mud pit, then stood on the bricks and kept using a spear to hit the crocodile's mouth.

[You caused 10 points of damage to the crocodile with a spear]

The crocodile's mouth had been corroded by sulfuric acid solution and was bloody.

The refined sulfuric acid solution is many times stronger than the corrosive power of acid rain.

Even so, it only caused 5 points of damage to the crocodile per second, which shows how abnormal the crocodile's overall defense is.

Now the crocodile's mouth can be said to be riddled with holes, and its defense is basically 0. Wang Shuo dealt full damage without any hindrance.

But the good times didn't last long. The clever crocodile stopped roaring and shut up.

Wang Shuo had to attack the crocodile's eyes instead.

As the crocodile's eyelids were also very hard, Wang Shuo tried many times before he stabbed it once.

The spear tip got stuck in the eye socket, causing the crocodile to shake its head in pain. Wang Shuo held the spear tightly, but was also shaken and couldn't control his body.

But he just didn't let go, and finally gave him another chance. When Wang Shuo's body, spear, and crocodile's head were in the same direction, Wang Shuo raised all his strength and stabbed hard.

The spear pierced the crocodile's head.

[You caused 100 points of damage to the crocodile with the spear, causing bleeding effect, 10 points per second. ]

The crocodile, feeling the pain, threw Wang Shuo out at once.

Wang Shuo hit the bricks, and his blood was surging, but fortunately, his health was not reduced.

After Wang Shuo's fatal blow, the crocodile could be said to be at the end of its strength.
